data.name: Nihansh
data.gender_notes: Nihansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words 'ni' (victorious) and 'hansh' (lion). The name Nihansh represents a brave and powerful warrior, triumphant over all challenges and adversities. The name Nihansh carries the meaning “Victorious Lion” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nihansh usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying the courage and strength of a lion, Nihansh embodies the divine power within.
data.etymology: Nihansh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious Lion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nihansh total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

The connotations of the name, with its associations with the mighty lion and the idea of victory, make it a powerful and inspiring choice for a child in this tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: At a deeper spiritual level, the name Nihansh can be seen as a reminder of the inner strength and courage that we all possess. It serves as a reminder that, like a lion, we can face and overcome even the greatest challenges with grace and determination. In this way, the name carries a powerful message of resilience and fortitude, inspiring us to live our lives with conviction and purpose.
